## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List relevant checks and any limitations.

## Independent agent review gate

Required before every merge under `AGENTS.md`; the author cannot approve their own changes.

- [ ] A subagent or separate agent that did not author the changes reviewed every applicable rule, including copy, visual quality, both languages, and portrait/landscape usability.
- [ ] The review records the reviewer, final commit SHA, each rule's assessment (pass with evidence, not applicable with reason, or violation/unverified), and relevant screenshot/interaction evidence. Private local requirements are represented only by a compliance conclusion.
- [ ] All applicable requirements are verified, findings are resolved, and the independent reviewer approved the final commit. Later changes have been re-reviewed.
